label: ITR JSON: where each SimplyFile figure goes
aliases: itr json: where each simplyfile figure g
description_nl: Each row: a path in the CBDT JSON and the SimplyFile fact it takes (=text, #number for a fixed value). A list row ('each') writes one item per TDS line, challan or bank account. What is not here stays as the schema's empty default and is completed in the department's utility (balance sheet, P&L, schedules). 2026-10-06: ITR-1 (Sahaj) for My return - an individual's salary, up to two houses, other sources, Chapter VI-A, the tax computation, TDS, challans and refund bank; rows with `each` write a list, skip_zero leaves an optional block out when its figure is nil, seed gives an optional block its required fields first. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 for My return - salary (Schedule S), other sources (Schedule OS), Chapter VI-A, this year's income through CYLA/BFLA (no losses carried), capital gains as totals (111A at 20%, 112/112A at 12.5%), the computation, TDS, challans and refund bank. The capital-gains schedule's scrip-wise rows are completed in the department's utility. 2026-10-06: ITR-4: ITR-1's rows at ITR-4's paths, plus Schedule BP (44ADA / 44AD: nature, receipts by mode, income) and the GSTIN turnover. 2026-10-06: ITR-4 has no OptOutNewTaxRegime (the old regime for business income is Form 10-IEA: F10IEACurrAYOldRegime) and no TotalIntrstPay. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 / ITR-4 PersonalInfo.Status from the client's status (I / H), not always I. 2026-10-06: ITR-2 / ITR-4 verification from the signer (the person, or an HUF's Karta) - 6 rows. 2026-10-06: 80DD, 80DDB, 80EE, 80EEA, 80EEB, 80GG, 80GGC rows and Schedules 80DD, 80EE, 80EEA, 80EEB, 80GGC for ITR-1, ITR-2 and ITR-4. 2026-10-06: Section80DDBUsrType only in the claimed block (UsrDeductUndChapVIA). 2026-10-07: ITR-3 / ITR-5 ItrFilingDueDate from filing.due_rule - the CBDT schema lists only the Act's own due dates, never a circular's extension. 2026-10-07: co-owners and the person's share in every Schedule HP; the employer's PIN; ITR-2 winnings (Schedule OS 115BB / 115BBJ and their date ranges), Schedule VDA and the 115BBH gain in Schedule CG / Part B-TI, Schedule SI (every special rate), Schedule EI and partial integration (Part B-TTI tax on the aggregate and the rebate on agricultural income); ITR-1 agricultural income up to 5,000; ITR-4 44AE (nature, each goods carriage, income). 2026-10-07: ITR-2 capital gains in full: Schedule 112A per scrip; Schedule CG A1 / A2 / A5 (land / building, 111A, other assets) and B1 / 112A / others (land / building with both computations and the excess tax), Table D (54 / 54EC / 54F with the CGAS deposit), Table E (this year's losses set off across rates), Table F (when the gains were made); CYLA / BFLA capital-gain and house rows, Part B-TI (losses brought forward, carried forward), Schedule CFL, Schedule TDS3 (194IA), gifts in Schedule OS (56(2)(x)). 2026-10-07: ITR-3 myreturn - My return's own ITR-3: every ITR-2 row at its ITR-3 path (Part B-TTI's tax under TaxPayableOnTI, the old regime as Form 10-IEA F10IEACurrAYOldRegime, the Act's due date, a business receipt's TDS under head BP), plus Part A-GEN2 (44AA, income declared under 44AD / 44ADA / 44AE, nature of business), Part A-P&L 61-63 (presumptive) and 64 (no regular books: receipts by mode, gross profit, expenses, net profit), Part A-BS no-books figures, Schedule BP, the business head in Part B-TI / CYLA / BFLA. Made by tools/make_itr3_myreturn.py from the ITR-2 rows. 2026-10-07: wave 3 (ITR-2): FilingStatus - the condition of the residential status, the days in India, a non-resident's country of residence and TIN, 115H; Schedule FSI (per country: salary, house, capital gains, other sources - income, tax paid abroad, Indian tax, relief, DTAA article), Schedule TR (relief u/s 90 / 90A / 91), Schedule FA (A1-A4, B, C), Schedule SPI (clubbed income), Schedule EI 10(32); Part B-TTI TaxRelief (89 / 90 / 91) and NetTaxLiability after it; a foreign employer's / house's ZIP code and country, the owner of a clubbed house. ITR-1 / ITR-4: Section89 and NetTaxLiability after it.
